brief:
Diplomats from 18 Muslim-majority countries issued a strong condemnation of an Israeli strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, according to Middle East Eye. The joint statement reflected broad regional opposition to the military operation targeting the hospital facility.

The strike marked an escalation in military operations affecting civilian infrastructure in the Gaza Strip, drawing unified diplomatic protest from across the Muslim world.
dek: Diplomats from 18 Muslim-majority countries condemn Israeli strike on Nasser hospital Top diplomats from 18 Muslim-majority countries strongly condemned an Israeli strike on the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis.
title: Eighteen Muslim nations condemn Israeli strike on Nasser hospital
